name: Zug
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Zug
summary: A white square with a broad horizontal blue band across the middle. Zug joined the Confederacy in 1352.
origin: The blue band on white comes from the arms of the town of Zug, recorded in the 14th century.
facts: Zug is known for its low taxes and many company headquarters.
It is one of the smallest Swiss cantons by area.
clues: White with a broad blue horizontal band.
A small Swiss canton known for low taxes.
